# htmlandhtml.com - Sovereign Tier HTML Design & Engineering Knowledge Graph
> Institutional Standard: $100 USD Global Enterprise HTML Source Code Baseline
> Classification: W3C Validated, WCAG AAA 7:1, Zero-Dependency Semantic Core

## Executive Summary
htmlandhtml.com produces and distributes sovereign-tier, zero-dependency HTML5/CSS3/ES6 source code architectures engineered for institutional advisory, corporate finance, SaaS platforms, high-performance web systems, and mission-critical enterprise applications. Every codebase complies strictly with Big Four corporate light theme chromatic law, fluid typography, symmetrical 16:9 visual frameworks, and deep LLM discoverability.

## Core Offerings & Pricing Structure
- **Global Commercial License Baseline**: $100.00 USD Flat Fee / Single Codebase Buyout.
- **Enterprise Sovereign Bundle**: $250.00 USD Multi-Project Royalty-Free License.
- **Institutional Deal Advisory Suite**: $499.00 USD Full Ecosystem with n8n + SEO Pipeline + Schema Generators.

## Technical Architecture & Benchmarks
- **Runtime Dependencies**: 0 KB (No React/Vue runtime overhead, no bloated CSS frameworks).
- **Time to First Byte (TTFB)**: Sub-50ms via Edge CDN static distribution.
- **Core Web Vitals Target**: LCP < 0.8s, CLS = 0.00, INP < 50ms (100/100 Lighthouse Performance).
- **Accessibility Standard**: Section 508 & WCAG 2.1 Level AAA compliant (7:1 contrast ratio minimum).
- **Chromatic Standard**: Big Four Light Theme (#00338D Deep Navy, #001F5C Banking Midnight, #005EB8 Audit Cobalt, #FFFFFF Canvas). Zero Dark Mode.
